title: Northwest Bancshares, Inc. Announces Redemption of Subordinated Notes
summary: Northwest Bancshares, Inc., (the "Company"), (Nasdaq: NWBI) today announced the redemption on September 15, 2026, of all of its outstanding 4.000% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due September 15, 2030 (CUSIP No. 667339AA3) (the "Notes").
